binding_conditions.note: critic.py records the newline-normalised digest, not the raw byte hash. Compare the digest the checker actually read.

admissible.answers: Is this rule well-posed and honestly testable under the gate sheet and this bar?
admissible.licenses: dated-record ADMIT that the test completed; candidate may stay live; Operator note / park row

established.answers: Did the rule clear the locked numerical bar as edge, after confirmation?
established.licenses: method establishment verdict on this lane only, and only after promotion into the gated method has fired
established.unreachable_because: nothing in the running loop calls rules.decide(); paper.py fills every candidate window and never consults the registry, so no lived L2 can exist
established.execution_flip_rule: execution=false -> true is legitimate only before the first L2-eligible window closes, recorded with a commit SHA and timestamp. Flipping after an L2 window has closed, or flipping to make a replayed look read as lived, is forbidden.
established.scope: scoped to the regimes actually observed; does not generalise past them

looks.first_look_n_changed_because: at n=40, delta/MDE was 0.997 — the effect floor was the critical value relabeled
looks.held_out_regime: strictly forward of L1, which is strictly forward of declared_at; rules.py window_is_oos enforces closed > declared, strict
looks.forward_only_enforced_by: the L1 score note must be committed before the 71st eligible window closes, recording that commit SHA and timestamp; the forward_only key alone is not the control
looks.peeking: forbidden — do not score before n=70; do not read L2 while scoring L1; prove it by commit order

l2_test.delta: the same delta in force when L1 was scored; it does not move between looks
l2_test.alpha: alpha_k from the same schedule, using the counter value after L1's increment

distinguishable.contrast: d_i = pnl_rule_fee_adj_i - pnl_baseline_fee_adj_i on the same n windows
distinguishable.h0_changed_because: at a calibrated mark a fill is EV-zero pre-fee and the fee is strictly positive on every fill, so E[d] > 0 for any nonzero skip rate with no selection skill present; the drafted null was known false before any data were collected
distinguishable.alpha_changed_because: 0.05/k weights are the harmonic series and diverge; FWER over the bar's own 14-look week is 15.2%, not 5%. 0.05/(k(k+1)) sums to 0.05 over unbounded looks, so FWER <= 0.05.
distinguishable.trials_counter: LEARNING_LANE_15M_RULES.json trials_to_date; increments on DECLARATION of a selection rule, not on score; L2 looks increment too
distinguishable.trials_counter_owed: no code reads or writes trials_to_date; a mechanical increment plus an invariant that fails when a score note exists without a matching increment is owed to Systems
distinguishable.effect_floor_rationale: delta is NOT derived from the critical value. Detection floor at n=70 with sd ~0.784 (the 95% upper confidence bound on the 0.66 point estimate from 56 calibration windows, since delta is linear in sd): 1.960 * SE_70 = 0.1837, so delta 0.28 sits at 1.52x the detection floor. At the drafted n=40 the ratio was 0.997 and the floor was the rejection threshold relabeled.
distinguishable.effect_floor_owed: delta re-derived from what size of edge is worth acting on. No decision-relevance anchor exists today (paper-only, HOLD stands, no capital at risk), so 0.28 is carried provisionally with the coincidence labeled. This bar cannot bind on delta alone.

power.power_at_delta: alpha, by construction — testing against a floor means power at the floor is the test level
power.honest_reading: with per-window sd near 0.66-0.78 and an n reachable in under two days, this lane can only detect very large effects; that is a property of the tape and the $1 unit, not a defect the bar can amend away

matched_exposure.detail: the rule arm risks (1 - skip_rate) * n * $1 against the baseline's n * $1; the raw contrast measures volume as well as selection
matched_exposure.control: permutation null holding the number of skips fixed and reassigning which windows are skipped
matched_exposure.requirement: observed mean(d) must exceed the (1 - alpha_k) quantile of that null, in addition to clauses (1), (3) and (4)
matched_exposure.why: converts the question from 'did abstaining help?' to 'did this abstention rule beat abstaining at the same rate?'
also_report: mean(d) per dollar at risk beside mean(d) per window
skip_rate * mean(fee | skip) — the mechanical fee-avoidance component of the contrast

clauses: (1) one-sided paired t-test, H0: mean(d) <= delta, reject only if p < alpha_k
(2) multiplicity: alpha_k = 0.05 / (k(k+1)), k = trials_to_date + 1, increment after the look
(3) effect floor delta = 0.28 * stake, absorbed into clause (1) as the null
(4) positive side: mean(pnl_rule_fee_adj) > 0 on those same n windows — binding, not conditional prose
(5) matched-exposure permutation control, fixed skip count, >=10,000 draws, seed 20260908
distinguishable.kill_if_not_distinguishable: park the rule; do not retune the band

fee_hurdle.measured_on: first 24 lineage-A books in the RUN-ONLY note
fee_hurdle.display: fee-accurate figures live in the score note / Operator note only; never hub, digest, manifest, records[]
fee_hurdle.schedule_hash_owed: no sha256 pinned; k=0.07 is used on habit and a schedule change would be invisible. This is a standing blocker on binding condition 2.
fee_hurdle.fee_monotonicity_detail: with stake fixed at $1, C = stake/P and Kalshi's 0.07 * C * P * (1-P) reduces exactly to 0.07 * stake * (1 - P): $0.0455 at P=0.35, $0.035 at P=0.50, $0.014 at P=0.80
fee_hurdle.band_skip_does_not_avoid_fee: a rule that skips the middle of the mark distribution skips the middle of the fee distribution and keeps the most fee-expensive fills; 'avoids the fee' is not available as a thesis for a coinflip-band skip on this book
fee_hurdle.spread_detail: paper_mark is public_mid_or_last(...) — the mid whenever both sides are quoted — and the payout is 1/mark, so the book buys at the mid and is paid at the mid while the RUN-ONLY note charges a taker fee. A taker pays the ask.
fee_hurdle.spread_cost_per_dollar_stake: s / (p + s); about $0.010 per fill at p=0.50 on a one-cent book, about $0.020 on a two-cent book — the same order as the $0.039 mean fee
fee_hurdle.spread_cost_direction: at a constant tick, s/(p+s) DECREASES in p ($0.0164 at p=0.30, $0.0099 at 0.50, $0.0055 at 0.90), so it runs the same direction as the fee, not the opposite; a band skip avoids neither cost's worst region
fee_hurdle.fee_adjusted_figure_remains_optimistic: by an unmeasured amount of the same order as the fee; no fee-adjusted number produced under this bar may be presented as a full cost accounting
fee_hurdle.adjustment_owed: a committed, tested fee_adjust(recorded_pnl, posted_yes, stake) in evidence_bar.py that the score note cites, so the adjustment is reproducible rather than retyped. Owed to Systems before this bar binds.

preregistration.requirement: a selection rule's parameters count as pre-registered only with (a) the commit SHA and timestamp of the registry entry that first names them, and (b) a statement that this timestamp predates the earliest window whose mark informed the parameter, including marks published anywhere on this tree

rules.detail: the RUN-ONLY note published mark and recorded pnl for 24 lineage-A windows 8h07m before the band was dated; 8 of those 24 rows fall strictly inside the band
rules.consequence: L1 cannot support an Established verdict even if it passes every clause. L1 may still be scored and may still support an Admissible dated record.
rules.dies_if: a commit, desk line, or dated artifact predating 2026-09-07T21:49:37-04:00 names the (0.45, 0.55) band; none was found in the history

calibration.used: 56 settled lineage-A books with close at or before 2026-09-08T05:56:00-04:00 (071545-45 through 080545-45, excluding missing 072245)
calibration.sd_is_one_number_from_one_stretch: the 0.66 point estimate comes from 56 windows inside a single ~14-hour period; the bar uses its 95% upper confidence bound 0.784 wherever delta is compared to a detection floor. Recompute both when more tape exists.

unit_dependence.detail: delta = $0.28 per window is meaningful only because PAPER_UNIT = 1.0 and stake_usd = 1.0; read delta as 0.28 * stake
unit_dependence.owed: an invariant that fails when PAPER_UNIT != 1.0 while this bar is binding (owed to Systems)
